title: Miss Violet May Barrett - Missing Person Located

page_data.en:
FM. 2
G. 90M-1-35

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No. ..........
S.1, Special Branch. XXXXX,
REPORT    Date October 3, 1939.

Subject. Miss Violet May BARRETT - Missing Person Located.

Made by. D.S. Pitts,    Forwarded by. C. Gauson

At about 9.15 p.m. October 2, 1939, the
D.C. (Divisions) telephoned D.S.Pitts and informed him
that a British woman named Violet May BARRETT, aged 31,
a stewardess from the P. & O. s.s. "Viceroy of India"
had been missing since 9 a.m. October 1, from her ship
lying in the Whangpoo River. The D.C. (Divisions)
added that a report to this effect had already been
made to Central Station by the ship's purser and that
he understood that the missing woman was an acquaintance
of a Shanghai resident named Mrs. Mc LEOD. The D.C.
(Divisions) instructed that efforts be made to locate
Miss BARRETT.

S.I. Firth, Central Station, was communicated
with; he explained that he had already spoken to Mrs.
Mc LEOD by telephone, that she resided at 401 Hamilton
House but could offer no material assistance in helping
to trace Miss BARRETT.

（印：SPECIAL BRANCH）

At 10 p.m. Mrs. McLEOD was interviewed by
D.S. Pitts; she consented to accompany him to local
hospitals, hotels, night clubs, bars, cabarets, etc. with
a view to pointing out the stewardess if she saw her.

Four hospitals, seven hotels, and numerous
bars, night clubs, restaurants and cabarets were then
visited before Miss BARRETT was finally located at 11.50
p.m. in D.D.'s Restaurant, Avenue Joffre. She was
under the influence of drink and in the company of a
German named BORST, residing at the Park Hotel.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。    档案编号 ..........
S.1，特别股。 XXXXX，
报告    日期 1939年10月3日。

事由：维奥莱特·梅·巴雷特（Violet May BARRETT）小姐——失踪人员已寻获。

呈报人：警佐皮茨（D.S. Pitts），    转呈人：高森（C. Gauson）

1939年10月2日晚9时15分左右，分区副督察长（D.C. (Divisions)）致电警佐皮茨，告知一名名为维奥莱特·梅·巴雷特（Violet May BARRETT）的英国女性，31岁，系“印度总督号”（Viceroy of India）轮船（隶属于半岛与东方航运公司 P. & O.）的女服务员，自10月1日上午9时起从停泊于黄浦江上的该轮失踪。分区副督察长（D.C. (Divisions)）补充称，该轮事务长已向中央巡捕房提交了一份此类报告，且他获悉该失踪女子与一位名为麦克劳德夫人（Mrs. Mc LEOD）的上海居民相识。分区副督察长（D.C. (Divisions)）指示设法寻找巴雷特（BARRETT）小姐的下落。

已与中央巡捕房的特别股督察员弗斯（S.I. Firth）取得联系；他解释说，他已通过电话与麦克劳德夫人交谈过，她居住在汉密尔顿公寓（Hamilton House）401室，但在协助追踪巴雷特（BARRETT）小姐方面无法提供实质性帮助。

（印：特别股）

晚10时，警佐皮茨会见了麦克劳德夫人（McLEOD）；她同意陪同他前往当地医院、旅馆、夜总会、酒吧、歌舞厅等处，以便在见到该女服务员时将其指认出来。

随后走访了四家医院、七家旅馆以及众多酒吧、夜总会、餐馆和歌舞厅，最终于晚11时50分在霞飞路（Avenue Joffre）的 D.D. 餐馆找到了巴雷特（BARRETT）小姐。当时她处于醉酒状态，并与一名名为博斯特（BORST）的德国人在一起，此人居住在国际饭店（Park Hotel）。

G. SOM-1-35

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No. ............

                                Station,
            REPORT
                                Date....................19
              - 2 -

Subject...............................................................

Made by. ....................    Forwarded by...................................

The situation was quickly explained to
Miss BARRETT who, after a little persuasion, was taken
to the Customs Jetty, where at midnight, she boarded
the launch MOYNA which took her to her ship at Buoys
11 and 12.

She was seen on the steamer after which
D.S. Pitts returned to Central Station in order to
cancel the teleprinter message previously sent out by
Central Station to acquaint all stations of her dis-
appearance.

                                D. S.

D.C. (Special Branch).

上海公共租界工部局警务处。    档案编号 ............

                                巡捕房，
            报告
                                日期....................19
              - 2 -

事由...............................................................

呈报人： ....................    转呈人...................................

情况迅速向巴雷特（BARRETT）小姐作了解释，经稍加劝说后，她被带至海关码头，并于午夜时分登上“莫伊纳号”（MOYNA）交通艇，该艇将她送往停泊在11号和12号浮筒处的所属轮船。

在轮船上见到她之后，警佐皮茨返回中央巡捕房，以撤销此前由中央巡捕房发出、通知各巡捕房其失踪情况的电传消息。

                                D. S.

特别股副督察长（D.C. (Special Branch)）。
